description: An eight-stage sequencer whose stages are not flat: each has a value, a shape the value is drawn with, a number of beats, and a displacement pushing its boundary earlier or later

params.text: Sets that stage's value, -5V to 5V, which the stage's shape is drawn against
Sets how many beats that stage lasts, 0 to 10; at 0 the stage is skipped
Morphs the shape that stage draws, 1 to 12, through a flat step, a square, a sawtooth, an inverted sawtooth, a triangle, a logarithmic ramp, a bell curve and a flat-topped ramp
Pushes the boundary between those two stages earlier or later, -5V to 5V, without changing how many beats the pair takes together
Jumps the sequence to that stage on the next clock beat
Sets how far the CV output slides toward each new value, the time scaled against the measured beat length
Starts the sequence on each press and stops it on the next
Returns the sequence to the first stage on each press
Makes each stage's beat count divide the stage rather than lengthen it, so the whole sequence keeps one length however the beats are set
Lets a stage's value CV keep moving the output through the stage, instead of the value being sampled once as the stage begins

inputs.text: Each rise advances the sequence by one beat and sets the tempo the shapes are drawn against
Replaces that stage's value knob, clamped to -5 to 5V; with the menu set to modulate shape it is added to that stage's shape knob instead
Changes the displacement of that boundary, added to its knob and clamped to -5 to 5V
Changes the slew, scaled by a tenth and added to the slew knob, the total clamped to the knob's travel
A rise starts the sequence, and the next stops it
A rise returns the sequence to the first stage
A voltage above 0.05V flips the link setting from whatever the button has it at, rather than replacing it
A voltage above 0.05V flips the track setting from whatever the button has it at, rather than replacing it

outputs.text: The sequence's voltage, the current stage's value drawn through its shape, slewed, and snapped to semitones on the menu setting
A 10V gate on the first half of every beat of the current stage, so a stage set to several beats puts out several gates
Carries 10V while the sequence is on that stage and 0V otherwise, whether or not the sequence is running

notes: nothing runs until a clock is patched and the sequence is started, by the ON/OFF button or a rise at the ON/OFF jack
the displacement controls move a boundary between two stages, so turning one makes one stage longer and its neighbour shorter by the same amount
menu: Stage Value CV Modulates Shape — sends each stage's value input to that stage's shape knob instead of its value, so a patched CV morphs the drawn shape
Quantize CV Out — snaps the CV output to whole semitones
